report: Facebook is the highest-impact priority: it supplies 60.91% of leads but only 19.28% of enrollments, with 0.65% L2E, A2E as its weakest stage, and a 34.55 estimated enrollment gap; LinkedIn is a distant second at 1.17, with W2A weakest. Google is a relative strength, generating 26.51% of enrollments from 13.91% of leads at 3.89% L2E, while Others contributes 21.69% of enrollments from 4.95% of leads at 8.96% L2E. Spend comparisons are limited to 3 of 8 sources (37.5% coverage), and benchmark gaps are counterfactual prioritization estimates—not demonstrated causes or guaranteed recoverable enrollments.
